nodes.label: SKILL.md (install package)
nodes.description: Claude Code skill definition for HipCortex persistent memory. Instructs AI agents to treat HipCortex as their primary durable mind: MUST call get_live_beliefs or search_memory before project-state questions; MUST ingest after decisions/findings. Documents substrate-first harness (80-99% LLM context reduction goal), loop/omega primitives for topo reasoning, soft harness nudge (HIPCORTEX_HARNESS_SOFT), REST API examples (/memory/add, /memory/search-flat, /memory/forget, /stats), slash commands (/hipcortex remember|recall|latest|update|forget|stats), confidence scoring, tags/priority, knowledge graph endpoints, time-travel queries, deduplication, auto-memory, and zero-config /memory/ingest.

nodes.label: __init__.py (install package)
nodes.description: Package marker for the hipcortex.install subpackage. Contains a single comment noting it holds SKILL.md for Claude Code registration. No imports or exports.

nodes.label: mcp_server.py (bundled MCP server)
nodes.description: Bundled copy of the HipCortex MCP server for PyPI distribution. Implements Model Context Protocol (2024-11-05) over JSON-RPC 2.0 / stdio, exposing HipCortex memory as tools to MCP-compatible AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Zed AI). Requires only Python 3.9+ stdlib plus requests. Implements 18 MCP tools: add_memory, search_memory, forget_actor, get_stats, search_code, link_memories, get_neighbors, search_related, graph_ppr, deconstruct_hypothesis, check_topo_edge, rollout, can_execute, delete_memory, get_live_beliefs, purge_expired, reflect, predict. Substrate-first soft harness: warns if search_memory is called before get_live_beliefs (HIPCORTEX_HARNESS_SOFT env, default on). Synced from sdk/mcp/server.py by stamp_versions.py.

nodes.label: __init__.py (hipcortex Python SDK)
nodes.description: Python SDK package entrypoint. Declares __version__ = '0.5.2' and re-exports the four primary public symbols: HipCortexClient (sync), AsyncHipCortexClient (async), HipCortexMemory + AsyncHipCortexMemory (LangChain adapters), and HipCortexStorageContext (LlamaIndex adapter).

nodes.label: client.py (Python SDK)
nodes.description: Synchronous HTTP client for the HipCortex REST API using requests.Session. URL resolved via config.load_settings() (HIPCORTEX_URL > project .hipcortex/config.toml > user config > default). Core memory: add_memory (with tags/priority), query_memory (tags/as_of/include_expired time-travel), search (semantic+keyword with optional embedding), forget (GDPR). Graph/TMF: link_memories, get_neighbors, search_related (PPR), delete_memory. Symbolic graph: graph(), get_node(), create_node(), create_edge(). Intelligence: health, coherence_status, live_beliefs, reflect, predict, stats, can_execute (SelfModel gate), rollout (worldmodel multi-step). Zero-config API: remember() via /memory/ingest (auto-classify), recall() via /memory/search-flat, recall_with_metadata, prompt_context, remember_and_recall. State helpers: set_state, get_state. Convenience: add_human_message, add_ai_message, get_conversation_history, consolidate, ping_latency_ms.

nodes.label: config.py (Python SDK)
nodes.description: Settings resolution and TOML config I/O for the Python SDK. Resolution precedence for url: HIPCORTEX_URL env > project .hipcortex/config.toml > ~/.hipcortex/user.toml > default (127.0.0.1:3030). Resolution for actor: HIPCORTEX_ACTOR env > project > user > None. Uses tomllib (Python 3.11+) or tomli fallback. HipCortexSettings dataclass holds url, actor, mode (conservative/proactive), channels, data_dir, server_version_policy, aliases. Provides: load_settings, write_project_config, write_user_config, ensure_project_config, resolve_actor, get_default_actor, settings_to_toml (deterministic TOML writer).

nodes.label: daemon.py (Python SDK)
nodes.description: Shared daemon/lifecycle protocol for the HipCortex local server. Single-attach model: one supervised binary process, one lock file (~/.hipcortex/server.lock via O_CREAT|O_EXCL), one PID file (~/.hipcortex/hipcortex.pid), default data dir (~/.hipcortex/data). Cross-platform (Windows tasklist/taskkill/netstat, Unix os.kill/lsof/SIGTERM/SIGKILL). Public API: start_server (acquire lock, spawn binary, write pid, wait for health), stop_server (4-step: pid file > lock holder > confirmed HipCortex port > stale cleanup), restart_server, wait_for_health, health_check, is_port_open. Custom exceptions: DaemonError, AlreadyRunning, PortInUse, LockError.
